summary: PetVivo Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire PiezoBioMembrane, Inc. (PBM) via its wholly-owned subsidiary Merger Sub. Consideration consists of 3,000,000 shares of PetVivo restricted common stock, with milestone-based vesting tied to development and regulatory milestones. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The merger is structured as a reverse triangular merger, with PBM surviving as an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary. The filing lacks transaction value, premium, or expected close date. Watch for milestone achievement timelines and regulatory progress.
